_comment: THE SESSION'S MCP SURFACE — DECLARED, NEVER INHERITED.
which ignores user/global MCP config entirely.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS (2026-08-13): a headless `claude -p` inherits the
USER-level MCP config (/root/.claude.json) and every claude.ai account
connector. On 2026-08-13 the 10:35 open session died with 'Autocompact is
thrashing' after loading claude.ai Airtable, Cryptoquant docs, Hugging Face,
Interactive Brokers and Langfuse alongside the two servers it actually uses.
Their tool definitions and instruction blocks cost ~54KB of context in that
one run, on top of a 29.6KB brief and a 36KB research_log, and the session
compacted three times in three turns before the CLI killed it.
The tool ALLOWLIST was never the hole -- deploy/session_tools.sh grants only
agentic-trader (discovered) + 10 named Robinhood tools, so no other broker
was ever callable. This is a context budget, not a guardrail: connected
servers cost context whether or not their tools may be called.
⛔ NO SECRETS HERE, AND NONE MAY BE ADDED. Robinhood is a remote HTTP MCP
whose OAuth lives in the CLI's own credential store, not in this file. If a
server ever needs a key, it goes in .env and is referenced by the launcher --
